summary: Macedonian uses сум broadly for copular predication, while има/нема supply central existence, presence, absence, and possession meanings.

semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: сум + state predicate; lexical state predicates also occur
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: сум + result-state predicate or станува/остане-type change/result construction
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: сум + locative expression; се наоѓа is a lexical location alternative
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: се одржува / се случува / е according to event construction
semantic_map.SEM.TIME_DATE_PREDICATION: forms of сум, especially е/се, in common time/date predication
semantic_map.SEM.ORIGIN_AFFILIATION: сум од / origin or affiliation predicate
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: има/нема supplies ordinary possession as well as existence in many constructions
